text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: The magical energy you've absorbed hasn't subsided. It's because you're laying a hand on a power you can't control. To put it in Yuki's terms, it's not beautiful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
取り入れた魔力が収まり切れておらんな。
制御できぬ力などに
手を出すからそうなるのじゃ。
ユキ風に言えば
美しくない、
といったところかのう。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Don’t talk like me. So, what do you think, Illya? ...Do you think you can win?
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手にボク風に言わないでよ。
それで、
どうなのさイリヤ。
……勝てそう？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Who do you think you're talking to? I'm the ruler of the night. What about you? Are you scared?
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰に聞いておる。
わらわは夜を統べる者じゃぞ。
お主はどうなのじゃ？　
さすがに怖気づいたかのう？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Who are you asking? I'm the ruler of beauty, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰に聞いてるのさ。
ボクは美を統べる者だよ？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Heh... Very well. Let's go, Yuki. Don't let your guard down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ……
ならばよい。
ゆくぞユキ、
気を抜くでないぞ！
